name: ndi-front-office
description: NDI's Multi-Channel Front Office Assistant plugin for Claude Code and the Claude app, installable straight from this repo.

plugins.name: fo-01-front-office
plugins.description: Handle inbound customer requests on Slack and Google Chat from a single agent: answer FAQs from an approved knowledge base, qualify enquiries, escalate complaints and anything contractual to the right human team with full context, and log every interaction to a shared record. It refuses to improvise an answer the knowledge base does not carry.
